title: Address decentralised and subnational implementation settings
requirements:
- Describe implementation where responsibility is shared across national, state and local levels
- State the national level as principal frame while allowing subnational, regional and cross-border application
- Address national architectures implemented regionally (e.g. Italy FSE 2.0) and how the components apply
- Do not assume uniform governance, connectivity or digital identity
- Note that entry-point assessment can apply to programmes, cities or facility networks
- Give guidance on capacity building and long-term financing in these settings
